splitter: src/group_cv.py randomized_group_kfold (scikit-learn 1.5 GroupKFold cannot shuffle) + inner_group_split
partition_rule: whole groups only; outer test fixed first; inner validation drawn from outer-training groups

selection.untuned: baselines and tf_nn_deployed_config use one predefined configuration
selection.classification_threshold: fixed per task in config/target_registry.json (decision_threshold); never tuned

preprocessing: median imputation and standard scaling inside each model, fitted on the training partition only
network: src/train_spacecraft_fire_model.py build_scientific_keras_model: Dense 32 relu -> Dense 16 relu -> Dense 1; Adam lr 0.003; MSE on standardized target
dependence_note: The 25 outer folds come from 5 repeats over the same rows, so they are correlated re-splits, not 25 independent experiments. Per-seed pooled scores are reported to show repeat-to-repeat variation; neither spread is a confidence interval for new experiments.

group_definitions.macfp_pmma_peak_hrr: Testing laboratory. Runs from one lab share apparatus, specimen batch and procedure, so a whole lab is always kept in one partition. This is stricter than treating each run as independent.
group_definitions.flex_droplet_burning_rate_constant: Test date. Tests on the same day share a chamber fill and hardware setup, so a whole day is kept in one partition instead of treating each droplet as independent.
group_definitions.flex_extinction_outcome: Test date (same reason as the burning-rate task).
